sloka: सा घूर्णितमहाद्वारा प्रभग्नगृहगोपुरा।लङ्का त्रासाकुला रात्रौ प्रवृत्तेवाभवत्तदा ।। ६.७४.४० ।।
transliteration: sā ghūrṇitamahādvārā prabhagnagṛhagopurā।laṅkā trāsākulā rātrau pravṛttevābhavattadā ।। 6.74.40 ।।

translations.english: Then the mighty gates of Lanka shaking, homes shattered, stricken with fear that night it seemed Lanka was dancing.
